assumptions.ordering: canonical receive order, never sorted by exchange timestamps
assumptions.tie_order: market records, then scheduled actions at the same receipt instant
assumptions.passive_queue: visible depth ahead; only native sell trade volume advances buy queues; cancellations never assumed ahead; snapshots rebase conservatively
assumptions.unknown_taker_side: does not fill a passive order
assumptions.aggressive_fill: BBO-consistent observed L2 depth, adverse slippage, IOC unfilled market remainder
assumptions.market_impact: not modeled; historical tape is exogenous
assumptions.fees: actual simulated partial-fill notional times configured maker/taker bps
assumptions.markouts: first subsequently observed valid midpoint at/after each horizon
assumptions.fill_clock: passive fills are modeled when the eligible print is received, not backdated; late prints received after cancellation do not reconstruct lost queue priority
assumptions.position_excursions: observed executable bid versus remaining entry VWAP; signed MAE <= 0, MFE >= 0
assumptions.end_of_tape: no forced fills, acknowledgements, cancellations, marks or closes

latency_ms.basis: recorded tape receipts and realized simulated lifecycle samples, not live SLAs
